redistribution: Consume rights-cleared Canonical Standard Packs, provenance metadata, schemas and non-infringing normalized requirements only; never copy restricted source text automatically.
drift_policy: Report source, schema, pack, recipe, rights and exact-revision drift; require human review before changing this pin or adopting revised standard text.
rollback: Restore the prior exact standards_check revision in this passport, the index and integration/locks.json.
Continue using the current versioned SearchRight standards packs and native PRISMA renderer when StandardFlow is absent or incompatible.
Preserve failed consumer fixtures and do not overwrite a pack until provenance, licence, numbering and semantic checks pass.
claim_boundary: SearchRight remains authoritative for review/search state and PRISMA counts. StandardFlow may validate and render a receipt but cannot change screening decisions or reconstruct missing counts. The exact pin passed the producer foundation gates; merge, consumer parity, rights clearance and external validation remain separate evidence.
